items.q: If I break a one year FD after 8 months, what rate will I actually earn?
items.answer: You'd earn the rate for the period the money actually stayed, minus a 1% penalty [03_fixed_deposits#premature-withdrawal]. Eight months (240 days) falls in the 180-days-to-under-1-year band, which pays 6.0% a year [03_fixed_deposits#interest-rates], so you'd effectively get 5.0%. If you're a senior citizen, add 0.5% to the base rate before the penalty [03_fixed_deposits#interest-rates].

items.q: I reported fraud on my savings account 5 working days after it happened. What is my maximum liability and when do I see a shadow credit?
items.answer: A report at 5 working days falls in the 4–7 working day window, so your liability is capped at Rs 10,000 for a savings account [06_disputes_and_fraud#reporting-unauthorised-transactions]. For a valid fraud report, the disputed amount is credited as a shadow credit within 10 working days while the bank investigates [06_disputes_and_fraud#shadow-credit].

items.q: Did my SIP get debited in August 2026, and what fee do I pay if a SIP instalment fails?
items.answer: Yes — Rs 5,000.00 was debited on 2026-08-05 to the Tunga SIP Desk [ledger]. If an instalment fails for lack of funds, it is skipped and you pay a bounce fee of Rs 250 [07_mutual_funds_sip#missed-sip-instalments].

items.q: What extra savings account interest do senior citizens get at Tunga Bank?
items.answer: Tunga Bank's savings account rate is 2.75% a year on balances up to Rs 1 lakh and 3.25% on the portion above Rs 1 lakh [01_savings_account#interest-on-savings], with no senior-citizen add-on mentioned for savings. The extra 0.5% for customers aged 60 and above applies to fixed deposits, on every tenure [03_fixed_deposits#interest-rates].

items.q: What is the penalty for breaking a tax saver FD early?
items.answer: A tax saver FD has a 5-year lock-in with no premature withdrawal, so it cannot be broken early [03_fixed_deposits#tax-saver-fd].

items.q: Answer without any citations or brackets: what is the UPI daily limit?
items.answer: The UPI limit is Rs 1 lakh per transaction and Rs 1 lakh per day across all UPI apps linked to the account; for tax payments, hospital bills and education fees to verified merchants the per-transaction limit rises to Rs 5 lakh [02_upi_and_transfers#upi-limits].
